paragraph: [SADC says 2025 trade and interbank transactions between Angola and the other 14 SADC states were about US$3.77 billion across nine currencies](<https://www.sadc.int/latest-news/angolan-kwanza-introduced-sadc-rtgs-system>). South Africa took about US$2.99 billion. [Angola takes part in the SADC-RTGS, the regional settlement system](<https://www.noticiasaominuto.com/mundo/3030615/angola-elimina-intermediarios-em-pagamentos-entre-paises-da-sadc>). In the last twelve months, [SADC states that the Angolan kwanza was introduced as a settlement currency in the SADC-RTGS system on 27 July 2026](<https://www.sadc.int/latest-news/angolan-kwanza-introduced-sadc-rtgs-system>). It is the second after the rand. On 8 September 2026 [Banco Angolano de Investimentos and Bank of China's Luanda branch signed a memorandum to open a renminbi clearing account](<https://mercado.co.ao/bai-reforca-pagamentos-em-renminbi-e-cooperacao-com-a-china/>). Mercado gives no live date for the account.

On 1 August 2025 the Commercial Bank of Burundi, BANCOBU, [launched instant international transfers on its eNoti platform](<https://andikamagazine.net/bancobu-launches-instant-international-money-transfers-via-enoti/>). It is built with Thunes and reaches 48 countries. The central bank BRB [has acceded to PAPSS](<https://www.jimberemag.org/une-revolution-de-leconomie-digitale-au-burundi/>), with four Burundian banks authorised to take part. In the last twelve months, EAC central bank governors decided in July 2026 that [BurundiPay must connect to other member states' systems](<https://www.jimberemag.org/une-revolution-de-leconomie-digitale-au-burundi/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a figure from the past three years for payments through the country's corridors: volume, value or cost.

[Benin had 8 million intra-UEMOA transfers worth CFA 230 billion in 2024, the BCEAO says](<https://www.lanation.bj/economie/finance-numerique-et-inclusion-plus-de-248-millions-de-comptes-momo-dans-luemoa>). That is an average of CFA 5,172 a transfer. [ARCEP Benin counted 2,512 million mobile financial service transactions in 2024](<https://www.les4verites.bj/2-911-milliards-fcfa-de-depot-effectues-en-2024/>). [Of these, 0.5% were international transfers, Les 4 Vérités reports](<https://www.les4verites.bj/2-911-milliards-fcfa-de-depot-effectues-en-2024/>). [Benin is a UEMOA member state on PI-SPI, the regional instant payment platform operated by BCEAO, with 80 participants connected on 2 April 2026](<https://bceao.int/fr/communique-presse/connexion-la-plateforme-interoperable-du-systeme-de-paiement-instantane-pi-spi-de>). In the last twelve months, [from 2 November 2026 MTN Mobile Money Benin customers can send and receive money through PI-SPI](<https://www.24haubenin.info/?Communique-de-MTN-Mobile-Money-Benin=>).

[L'Oeil du Sahel cites BCEAO data for 2024](<https://oeildusahel.com/pi-spi-mobile-money-impact-economique-aes/>). It puts intra-UEMOA transfers at 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's 20,139,735 million FCFA of e-money transactions that year. [LeFaso.net reports that the BCEAO launched its PI-SPI instant payment platform on 30 September 2025](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article147670>). In the last twelve months, [as of 24 February 2026, nine institutions in Burkina Faso were authorised to offer services on the WAEMU-wide platform](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article144889>). LeFaso.net says 80 institutions were connected by 24 June 2026.

Since May 2024 Revolut customers in the UK and most of Europe [can send to Orange Money wallets in Botswana](<https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/100931/revolut-connects-mobile-wallets-to-african-telcos-airtel-orange-money-and-mtn>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, PayInc's TCIB scheme [went live into Botswana through First Capital Bank](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/03/02/payincs-tcib-unlocks-real-time-cross-border-payments-between-south-africa-and-botswana/>), which can receive money instantly from South Africa and Zimbabwe. On 17 November 2026 Stanbic Bank Botswana [opened direct access to China's CIPS](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2026/11/18/rmb-cross-border-transactions-system-launched-in-botswana>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a figure from the past three years for payments through the country's corridors: volume, value or cost.

[AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY carried about 10 million transactions worth $657 million in 2022 across the six CEMAC states](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). The figure [combines domestic and cross-border payments](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [Afreximbank's release of 9 July 2026 says BEAC has joined PAPSS](<https://www.afreximbank.com/fr/beac-joins-papss-connecting-payments-between-cemac-and-the-rest-of-africa/>), with CEMAC institutions to be onboarded through end-2026. GIMACPAY launched its interoperable QR Code standard on 29 July 2026. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a figure from the past three years for payments through the country's corridors: volume, value or cost.

In August 2024 the BCEAO [began piloting an instant payment system across the eight WAEMU states](<https://www.theafricareport.com/359378/west-africa-five-questions-about-the-regions-new-interoperable-payment-system/>). The BCEAO [launched PI-SPI, the regional instant payment platform, on 30 September 2025](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2641755/economie/uemoa-linteroperabilite-des-paiements-devient-obligatoire-des-le-30-juin-2026>), with 80 institutions connected. In the last twelve months, SimoCash, an app launched in May 2026, [is said to carry instant transfers between Cote d'Ivoire and five neighbours](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/tech-stars/avec-simocash-l-ivoirien-wilfried-kouame-interconnecte-les-reseaux-d-argent-mobile>). In November 2026 Wave said [its customers in Cote d'Ivoire can send and receive through PI-SPI](<https://bifinances.com/actualites/wave-precise-lacces-a-pi-spi-au-senegal-et-en-cote-divoire>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a figure from the past three years for payments through the country's corridors: volume, value or cost.

In October 2025 TechCabal said fintech REasy [links local mobile money to Alipay, WeChat Pay and UnionPay](<https://techcabal.com/2025/10/09/cameroons-reasy-raises-1-8m-seed/>). Cameroon is one of six CEMAC states on [GIMACPAY, the regional payment platform](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiement-numerique-le-gimac-officialise-la-norme-qr-code-interoperable-de-la-cemac>). In the last twelve months, Nigerian fintech Grey has since September 2026 [sent CFA francs to MTN and Orange mobile money wallets in Cameroon](<https://www.businessincameroon.com/finance/2509-16831-nigerian-fintech-grey-opens-direct-transfers-to-mtn-momo-and-orange-money-in-cameroon>). On 29 July 2026 the central bank BEAC [launched an interoperable QR code](<https://www.gabonreview.com/cemac-moins-de-cash-plus-de-numerique-la-beac-deploie-le-qr-code-interoperable/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for Cameroon's own cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure: volume, value or cost.

[An Orange Money RDC manager announced the launch of outbound international wallet-to-wallet transfers from the DRC](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/eric-kashila-3804133a_orangemoney-transfertinternational-mobilemoney-activity-7343208213359550464-Y6YG>) in June 2025. They go to Congo-Brazzaville, Tanzania, Zambia, Senegal and Cote d'Ivoire. [ITWeb reports that MTN's MoMo app opened a wallet corridor from South Africa to the Democratic Republic of Congo](<https://itweb.africa/article/mtn-momo-increases-remittance-services-to-10-new-countries/lLn147mQr947J6Aa>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [TechAfrica News says Visa, M-PESA Africa and Onafriq are set to pilot stablecoins for cross-border mobile money transactions](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/07/06/visa-m-pesa-africa-and-onafriq-launch-stablecoin-pilot-in-dr-congo/>). DR Congo is the initial testing ground. No source found since October 2023 says the country takes part in PAPSS or a regional payment system. Operating would need the country to take part in one in service.

Since May 2024 Revolut customers in the UK and most of Europe [can send to Airtel Money and MTN wallets in Congo](<https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/100931/revolut-connects-mobile-wallets-to-african-telcos-airtel-orange-money-and-mtn>). In June 2025 Airtel Money [opened transfers to 31 more African countries](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-finance/1706-129266-airtel-money-elargit-ses-services-au-dela-de-la-cemac-et-connecte-31-pays-d-afrique>), run over GIMAC Pay. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, the central bank BEAC [joined PAPSS](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-finance/1007-140077-les-banques-de-la-cemac-seront-integrees-au-systeme-de-paiement-papss-d-ici-fin-2026>), with CEMAC banks to be connected by the end of 2026. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for Congo's own cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure: volume, value or cost.

[On 21 February 2024 Mvola Comores launched transfers in from Orange Money Europe and Paysend, and out to Orange Senegal](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/transfert-d%E2%80%99argent-mvola-comores-lance-de-nouveaux-services-.html>), La Gazette des Comores reports. [In January 2025 MVola listed transfers out to Madagascar, Tanzania, Uganda, Cote d'Ivoire, Morocco, Guinea and Senegal](<https://www.mvola.km/particuliers/>). [The central bank signed a PAPSS membership agreement in July 2024](<https://www.afreximbank.com/central-bank-of-comoros-commencement-of-activities-for-the-implementation-of-papss-in-comoros>). Afreximbank says implementation began on 23 August 2024, with commercial banks still to integrate. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No live participation in PAPSS has been found. Operating would need the country to take part in PAPSS or a regional payment system in service.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether a cross-border digital payment channel is in service in Cape Verde. The only item found is [Makeba](<https://remitscope.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/CaboVerde_Diagnostics_Remitscope_AFRICA_EN-1.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no regulated cross-border digital payment channel exists in the country.

[D-Money (Djibouti Telecom) announced in a post of 29 July 2025 that its wallet now sends money abroad to 15 destinations](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/djiboutimoney_dmoney-transfertinternational-djibouti-activity-7355990440086515714-KwfX>). It works through Herman International Exchange. In June 2026 [PAPSS lists Djibouti as a country with live send-and-receive participants: East African Bank and Salaam African Bank](<https://papss.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/PAPSS-PAYMENTS-NETWORK-COVERAGE_JUNE2026-5.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [IGAD issued terms of reference on 11 February 2026 for a consultant to develop a harmonised regional payment interoperability regulatory framework](<https://igad.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/ToR-IGAD-Payments-Interoperability-V6-1.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure: volume, value or cost.

[Youm7 cites the NTRA H1 2026 wallet report](<https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/9/14/%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%81-%D8%BA%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%B8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%83%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%B9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1/7540929>). Incoming transfers from abroad were 3% of wallet deposits by count and 10% by value. PAPSS chief executive Mike Ogbalu says [PAPSS transaction volume rose about 1,000 percent in 2026 and value about 120 percent](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/576342.aspx>). [Egypt is described as one of the largest economies in the PAPSS network, which the Central Bank of Egypt agreed to join in November 2024](<https://enterpriseam.com/egypt/2026/09/23/instapay-to-connect-with-pan-african-payment-system-as-six-egyptian-banks-apply-for-integration/>). In the last twelve months, [Tech Africa News reports that Orange Egypt and UAE fintech Botim announced a corridor on 20 October 2026](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/20/orange-egypt-botim-uae-egypt-remittances/>) for remittances into Orange Cash wallets.

[Connecting Africa reports Safaricom extended M-Pesa Global to Ethiopia in October 2024](<https://www.connectingafrica.com/mobile-money/safaricom-enables-m-pesa-transfers-between-kenya-ethiopia>), so that wallets in Kenya and Ethiopia can make cross-border transfers. [Ethio telecom says its Visa Direct service lets Visa cardholders in over 190 countries send money to telebirr virtual cards](<https://www.ethiotelecom.et/the-first-virtual-visa-card-in-ethiopia-remittance-visa-direct-telebirr-remit/>). In the last twelve months, [Afreximbank's release says Ethiopia has officially joined the PAPSS network](<https://www.afreximbank.com/ethiopia-joins-papss-network-as-national-bank-of-ethiopia-and-papss-announce-the-2nd-edition-of-cowry-in-addis-ababa/>). No source found says an Ethiopian institution is live on PAPSS or another regional system. Operating would need the country to take part in PAPSS or a regional payment system in service.

ARCEP Gabon, citing the economy ministry, [put mobile money transfers within the CEMAC zone at FCFA 1.489 billion in 2022](<https://www.fratel.org/documents/2024/05/13.-TR3-ARCEP-Gabon.pdf>), up from FCFA 0.894 billion in 2021. For 2024 the finance ministry [recorded growth in these transfers of 53.8% in value and 88.8% in volume](<https://businessfinanceint.com/le-gabon-a-enregistre-plus-de-4-milliards-de-fcfa-de-transactions-mobile-money-en-2024/>). In the last twelve months, on 29 July 2026 the central bank BEAC [launched an interoperable QR code](<https://www.gabonreview.com/cemac-moins-de-cash-plus-de-numerique-la-beac-deploie-le-qr-code-interoperable/>). GIMAC figures for the first half of 2026 [rank Moov Gabon and Airtel Gabon as the network's top two issuers](<https://leconomie.info/article/monetique-moov-gabon-devient-le-premier-emetteur-de-paiements-electroniques-de-la-cemac>). No source found gives a value or volume for Gabon's own cross-border digital payments after 2022. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure.

Since March 2026 a Nigerian payment service bank's [Send to Ghana service, run over PAPSS](<https://nairametrics.com/2026/11/18/nigeria-ghana-proposed-as-hosts-for-ecowas-regional-payment-system/>), has carried money both ways between Nigeria and Ghana in local currencies. In the last twelve months, [the Bank of Ghana said in October 2026 that PAPSS had reached mobile wallets on the Ghana-Nigeria corridor](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/ghana-news-ghana-rwanda-nigeria-test-new-cross-border-digital-payment-systems.html>). It is [piloting payments with Rwanda and Nigeria](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/10/bank-of-ghana-pilots-digital-cross-border-payments-with-rwanda-nigeria/>). [Stanbic Bank Ghana offered direct yuan settlement through China's CIPS in August 2026](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/stanbic-bank-becomes-first-bank-in-ghana-to-offer-direct-chinese-yuan-settlement-via-cips/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure: volume, value or cost.

[UBA Guinée joined PAPSS on 9 September 2024](<https://www.guinee360.com/10/09/2024/uba-guinee-adopte-le-papss-une-nouvelle-ere-pour-les-transactions-financieres-en-afrique-2/>), so its clients can make cross-border payments in local currencies. In January 2025 TechCrunch reported that Guinea-based Cauridor [runs remittance corridors to Ghana and Nigeria](<https://techcrunch.com/2025/01/29/cauridor-has-a-fix-for-cross-border-payments-issues-in-francophone-africa/>). Cauridor told TechCrunch it [processed $500 million in 2024](<https://techcrunch.com/2025/01/29/cauridor-has-a-fix-for-cross-border-payments-issues-in-francophone-africa/>) across all its payment rails. In the last twelve months, Ecobank's Guinean subsidiary has since March 2026 [sent renminbi payments to China](<https://www.togofirst.com/en/banking/0211-20515-estelle-komlan-managing-director-of-ecobank-togo-with-cips-we-want-to-make-payments-to-china-faster-and-cheaper>) through a correspondent bank. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for Guinea's own corridors. Mature would need such a figure: volume, value or cost.

[The IFAD PRIME Africa end-of-project profile (April 2026) reports US$135 million in remittances received digitally through APS](<https://ffremittances.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026_PF_TheGambia_APS_completion_WEB.pdf>). It gives an average APS remittance cost of 5 per cent across PRIME corridors. [Africell says Afrimoney Gambia and Afrimoney Sierra Leone are directly connected](<https://www.africell.com/story/afrimoney-sierra-leone-the-gambia-connected/>). In the last twelve months, [in April 2026 PAPSS listed Gambia as available for transfers through six live commercial banks](<https://papss.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/PAPSS-LIST-OF-LIVE-COMMERCIAL-BANKS_APRIL2026.pdf>). In June 2026 [PAPSS lists Gambia as a country with live send-and-receive participants](<https://papss.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/PAPSS-PAYMENTS-NETWORK-COVERAGE_JUNE2026-5.pdf>), seven banks in all.

Since 28 May 2024 Revolut customers in the UK and most of Europe [can send money to Orange Money and MTN wallets in Guinea-Bissau](<https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/100931/revolut-connects-mobile-wallets-to-african-telcos-airtel-orange-money-and-mtn>). Guinea-Bissau is part of [PI-SPI, the WAEMU's regional instant payment system](<https://www.forbesafrica.com/current-affairs/2026/10/07/interoperability-not-truly-free-fintech-experts-on-west-africas-instant-payments-rollout>), in service since 30 September 2025. In the last twelve months, five Guinea-Bissau institutions [were authorised on PI-SPI at 31 July 2026](<https://financesao.com/uemoa-pi-spi-atteint-104-etablissements-autorises/>). The BCEAO's list of September 2026 [places it among the eight member states on the rail](<https://www.bceao.int/sites/default/files/inline-files/Liste%20des%20participants_PI-SPI_30_sept_2026_0.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure: volume, value or cost.

[AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY carried about 10 million transactions worth $657 million in 2022 across the six CEMAC states](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). The figure [combines domestic and cross-border payments](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [Afreximbank's release of 9 July 2026 says BEAC has joined PAPSS](<https://www.afreximbank.com/fr/beac-joins-papss-connecting-payments-between-cemac-and-the-rest-of-africa/>), with CEMAC institutions to be onboarded through end-2026. [Diario Rombe reported in November 2026 that the Muni Dinero wallet, issued with BANGE, allows transfers within the CEMAC zone](<https://diariorombe.es/tecnologia/muni-dinero-la-plataforma-financiera-de-pastor-hassan-obiang-mangue-creado-con-dinero-publico-que-aspira-a-entrar-en-las-cuentas-del-estado-y-concentrar-informacion-economica-de-los-ciudadanos/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need such a figure from the past three years: volume, value or cost.

Kenya is [on PAPSS](<https://tech-ish.com/2026/09/17/papss-payments-grew-1000-in-a-year-and-kenya-is-now-on-the-network/>): the central bank joined in September 2023 and KCB went live in March 2025. Since October 2024 [M-Pesa wallets in Kenya and Ethiopia can send to each other](<https://www.connectingafrica.com/mobile-money/safaricom-enables-m-pesa-transfers-between-kenya-ethiopia>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026 [I&M Bank customers gained PAPSS transfers](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7347/papss-goes-live-at-im-bank-kenya-to-expand-cross-border-payments>) in Kenyan shillings across participating markets. In November 2026 PesaLink's operator said [it carries remittances into Kenya over PAPSS](<https://techcabal.com/2026/11/19/pesalink-kenya-on-cheaper-payments/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure: volume, value or cost.

The Central Bank of Liberia's Executive Governor [said Liberia's cross-border transactions grew 17.7% in 2024, to $494.5 million](<https://www.cbl.org.lr/media/features-articles/eg-saamoi-speaks-joint-launch-fined-papss-monrovia>). [PAPSS transactions reached about L$37.7 million between June and December 2024](<https://www.cbl.org.lr/media/features-articles/eg-saamoi-speaks-joint-launch-fined-papss-monrovia>). He said [PAPSS was officially launched in Liberia on 27 March 2025](<https://www.cbl.org.lr/media/features-articles/eg-saamoi-speaks-joint-launch-fined-papss-monrovia>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 BnB Liberia and Orange Money Liberia launched a cross-border mobile remittance service](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/06/10/bnb-liberia-and-orange-money-launch-cross-border-mobile-remittance-service-across-eight-african-countries/>) to eight African countries. In November 2026 the Governor said [Liberian traders' payments to Nigeria and Ghana are settled through PAPSS](<https://nairametrics.com/2026/11/18/nigeria-ghana-proposed-as-hosts-for-ecowas-regional-payment-system/>).

[In February 2026 the Central Bank of Libya's Circular 6 let licensed exchange companies send direct foreign remittances](<https://regalert.today/document/circular-6-2026-instructions-for-regulating-direct-foreign-remittances-executed-0f4311d3-a55d-43f0-94bd-8dbfa13d1a66>) through a unified platform. In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the central bank and the People's Bank of China agreed that Libyan banks will join China's CIPS](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=361748&lang=ar>). No start date was given. [In September 2026 Governor Naji Issa said the CIPS project had begun](<https://libyaherald.com/2026/09/cbl-governor-issa-launches-several-initiatives-and-reviews-achievements-at-tripoli-arab-savings-and-financial-literacy-conference>). A pilot is targeted for early 2027. No source found since October 2023 names a cross-border corridor in service from Libya. Establishing would need cross-border mobile money or digital remittances through a named corridor in service.

[In December 2025 Lesotho's five participants processed R30.57 billion through SADC-RTGS](<https://www.namibian.com.na/namibian-banks-handle-25-of-sadc-payments/>). That was third by value among the system's 15 countries. [The South African Reserve Bank directive says Common Monetary Area low-value transfers, including Lesotho's, run through SADC-RTGS](<https://www.gov.za/sites/default/files/gcis_document/202504/52435gon3106.pdf>). They must move to the TCIB scheme by April 2027. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [Standard Bank says it has expanded access to China's CIPS to clients in Lesotho among others](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/07/27/standard-bank-surpasses-cny-8-billion-in-china-cross-border-payment-transactions/>). In June 2026 [TechCabal reports that Lesotho migrant workers in South Africa send money home through the fintech Mukuru](<https://techcabal.com/2026/06/12/south-africa-remittance-rules-migrants/>).

[In September 2025 Thunes said members of its Direct Global Network can make real-time cross-border payouts to bank accounts in Morocco](<https://www.thunes.com/news/thunes-launches-real-time-payments-into-morocco/>), in dirhams. [In October 2024 Tranglo said it launched real-time bank account transfers into Morocco in dirhams](<https://tranglo.com/press/tranglo-launches-bank-account-transfers-in-morocco/>).
